sloka: राघवौ पतितौ दृष्ट्वा शरजालसमावृतौ ।बभूवुर्व्यथिताः सर्वे वानराः सविभीषणाः ।। ६.४६.७ ।।।।
transliteration: rāghavau patitau dṛṣṭvā śarajālasamāvṛtau ।babhūvurvyathitāḥ sarve vānarāḥ savibhīṣaṇāḥ ।। 6.46.7 ।।।।

translations.english: Unable to move, with feeble breath, drenched in blood and the body covered all over with arrows, lying on a bed of arrows, stunned, with reduced prowess, sighing like serpents, the heroes, Rama, and Lakshmana, who were like golden posts became dull. Rama and Lakshmana were lying on a heroic bed, arrows stuck to the bodies. Vibheeshana and all the Vanaras kept seeing both the scions and wept surrounding them.
